moon.name: Mare Tranquillitatis
moon.blurb: The Sea of Tranquility is a vast plain of dark volcanic rock. Apollo 11 landed near its edge in 1969.

moon.name: Tycho Crater
moon.blurb: A young crater about 85 kilometers wide. Bright streaks of ejected material stretch more than 1,500 kilometers across the Moon.

moon.name: Copernicus Crater
moon.blurb: A crater about 93 kilometers wide with terraced walls and a cluster of central peaks.

moon.name: Mare Imbrium
moon.blurb: The Sea of Showers filled with lava after a giant impact roughly 3.9 billion years ago.

moon.name: Oceanus Procellarum
moon.blurb: The largest dark plain on the Moon, stretching across much of the western near side.

moon.name: South Pole–Aitken Basin
moon.blurb: One of the largest known impact basins in the solar system, about 2,500 kilometers across, on the far side.

moon.name: Shackleton Crater
moon.blurb: Near the south pole. Parts of its floor never see sunlight and may hold water ice.

moon.name: Hadley–Apennine
moon.blurb: Apollo 15 landed beside Hadley Rille and drove the first Lunar Roving Vehicle here in 1971.

mars.name: Olympus Mons
mars.blurb: The tallest known volcano in the solar system, about 22 kilometers high, roughly two and a half times taller than Everest.

mars.name: Tharsis Region
mars.blurb: A huge raised region holding three giant volcanoes in a row: Arsia, Pavonis and Ascraeus Mons.

mars.name: Valles Marineris
mars.blurb: A canyon system about 4,000 kilometers long and up to 7 kilometers deep, far larger than the Grand Canyon.

mars.name: Gale Crater
mars.blurb: A crater about 154 kilometers wide with a 5-kilometer-high mound, Mount Sharp, at its center. Curiosity explores it.

mars.name: Jezero Crater
mars.blurb: A crater with the remains of a river delta. Perseverance landed here in 2021 to look for signs of past life.

mars.name: Hellas Planitia
mars.blurb: One of the largest impact basins in the solar system, about 2,300 kilometers wide and several kilometers deep.

mars.name: Utopia Planitia
mars.blurb: A vast smooth plain in the northern lowlands. Viking 2 landed here in 1976.

mars.name: North Polar Cap
mars.blurb: Layered water ice topped by a thin seasonal frost of frozen carbon dioxide.

mars.name: Ares Vallis
mars.blurb: An ancient flood channel. Mars Pathfinder and the Sojourner rover landed here in 1997.

mars.name: Gusev Crater
mars.blurb: A crater about 160 kilometers wide that may once have held a lake. The Spirit rover explored it.

mars.name: Meridiani Planum
mars.blurb: A flat plain with hematite, a mineral that often forms with water. The Opportunity rover landed here.

mars.name: Chryse Planitia
mars.blurb: A huge low plain where Viking 1 landed in 1976.

mars.name: Elysium Planitia
mars.blurb: A smooth plain near the equator where the InSight lander listened for marsquakes.

mars.name: Vastitas Borealis
mars.blurb: A cold northern plain where the Phoenix lander found water ice just under the soil.
